basis: 对用户认为刺眼、生硬的卫宫宅新增六区域进行画风纠正；复用已确认的街景作画风参考，旧合格和室、街景不重绘。
geometry: 提示要求保持原视角、门口、地面和占地；实际路线另由原地面／家具几何约束，已进行行走验证。
commonPrompt:
EDIT image 1 as a style correction; image 2 is the USER APPROVED soft residential anime-painting reference, not a replacement layout. The target was rejected as too photorealistic, dazzling, high contrast and hard.
Keep target camera, perspective, floor polygon, room boundaries, every doorway/window/threshold and all architectural / plant footprints PIXEL-ALIGNED to the original. Do not move, add or remove furniture or obstacles. This empty ground must remain available for independently drawn interactive furniture. No people, text or UI.
Repaint in the exact soft hand-painted Japanese anime background language of reference 2: cream and warm-grey plaster, muted matte cedar, subdued sage tatami, blue-grey cool reflected shadow fill, clear middle values. Remove orange varnish reflections, glaring gold pools, etched black edges, photographic fine texture and sparkling leaves. Use larger connected tree-shadow shapes, selective softened shadow boundaries, restrained warm morning daylight, delicate varied painted material transitions and natural brush edges. Keep fresh layered plants and selective crisp readable door thresholds; quiet secondary surfaces and distant contours. Wood is softly brushed matte material, not glossy polished plastic. A calm playable daily-life environment. Do not achieve this by a blanket blur, grey fog, dim filter, or uniform desaturation. Preserve native landscape aspect ratio and exact layout.

forecourt.prompt:
Edit target: image 1, the Emiya front courtyard. Style reference ONLY: image 2, the USER APPROVED soft residential street. The current target was rejected as overly photorealistic, dazzling, sharp and hard. Repaint the target to the SAME restrained hand-painted Japanese anime background language as reference 2.
Keep the target composition and ALL geometry exactly unchanged: camera, perspective, house silhouette, every gate/door/window opening, central stepping stones, gravel path, foreground gate opening, courtyard boundaries, rock/plant footprints and walkable clear space. This is a texture/light/edge paint correction, never redesign.
Replace photographic pebble-by-pebble microdetail with larger quiet painted gravel masses and selectively suggested small stones near the foreground. Plants are layered botanical shapes with soft varied brush edges, not tiny crisply outlined sparkling leaves. Keep cream plaster, muted warm cedar and blue-grey tiles. Light is broad mild late-morning daylight, with restrained warm highlights, cool blue-grey ambient fill and connected translucent crown shadows; compress harsh sunny-dark transitions and remove glare/bloom/white speckles. Wood is matte softly brushed cedar, not glossy varnish or orange reflections. Distant and secondary contours lose edge selectively; door thresholds and central path remain legible. Keep living fresh greens and real material differences; do not merely desaturate, fog, darken or blur the image. No people, labels, UI, new furniture or obstacles. Native full background at the same landscape aspect ratio.

shirouLife.prompt:
Use the first image as the exact Shirou Emiya character identity and rendering reference; create the matching domestic ACTION sheet. Preserve reddish-brown short hair, teen male proportions, navy/ivory raglan shirt, blue trousers and dark house slippers; the same restrained soft painted anime game finish, no harsh black outline, no shiny highlights.
Transparent RGBA sprite atlas, SIX columns, TWO rows of subtle action phases. One isolated COMPLETE figure per cell, with at least 20% padding on ALL four sides including feet. Never cross a cell boundary; keep body scale and contact consistent across both phases. No furniture, background, floor, shadows, checkerboard, labels or weapons.
Columns left to right: (1) sitting/kneeling at a low family table, hands relaxed; (2) kneeling with an open book, second phase turns a page; (3) standing facing left, preparing a simple meal with small ladle and bowl, second phase gentle stir; (4) sitting holding a small rice bowl and chopsticks, second phase lifts chopsticks; (5) calmly side-lying, head on left, knees lightly bent, eyes closed, second phase slight breathing; (6) sitting upright on a bench, thighs horizontal, lower legs hanging, hands on lap, second phase slight head movement. No table, stove, chair, bench or bed drawn. All twelve must be complete with generous blank separation; lying and seated poses naturally shorter than standing but retain anatomical scale.
